summary: Created a 4-phase implementation plan (3 waves, 1.5h) to loosen the plan-checklist mark-completed instruction in the three in-scope implementation agents so items are located by their existing item text instead of a literal '**Task {P}.{N}**:' prefix. The plan designates general-implementation-agent.md's Stage 4B-ii as the single canonical, verbatim-quotable home for the contract, so the two downstream sibling tasks adopt rather than paraphrase it. It also repairs a dangling cross-reference and records a named gap: the brittle idiom survives in seven source-store files, two of which (web and nvim implementation agents) no task in this cluster covers.
decisions_made: Canonical wording lives in agent-system/extensions/core/agents/general-implementation-agent.md, section '#### 4B-ii. Check Off Completed Items in Plan File'; the full text is quoted verbatim in the plan's 'Canonical Wording' section for the downstream siblings to copy.

Matching contract explicitly licenses matching on the item's core text and intent with formatting-drift tolerance, and explicitly forbids requiring a byte-exact template match, since byte-exact matching is the way this could fail silently a second time.
The six annotation suffixes (including U+2014 em-dashes) are preserved byte-for-byte; only the assumed leading line shape is genericized to {existing item text}.
Dropped the step-4 pointer to plan-format-enforcement.md 'for the full deviation annotation format' -- verified that file contains zero deviation-annotation content, making the reference dangling.
Phase 1 exclusively owns the shared core agent file; Phases 2 and 3 own disjoint files and can run in parallel.
